adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts, the code adds an unconditional fetch to 'https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token' and prisma.credential.update in the constructor/initialization path (lines 72-91). This happens every time the service is instantiated, regardless of whether the current access token is still valid. Other calendar services in this diff (like GoogleCalendarService, Office365CalendarService) have their refresh logic inside a 'refreshAccessToken' function that's called conditionally when tokens expire. The Salesforce implementation lacks this conditional check, causing unnecessary API calls and database writes on every instantiation.
